elimination of competitors. By age fifty, his wealth rivaled the main
house, though he lacked their title and legitimacy.

Married twice---both wives died of "illness." Currently widowed with
no legitimate heirs by deliberate choice. He believes legitimate
children would be targets, liabilities, or rivals. Instead, he's
positioning himself to claim Lord Aldris IV's daughter Serina through
adoption or marriage alliance when he takes over the main house.

Rumored to have several illegitimate children across both continents,
used as agents but never acknowledged.

#### Secrets


**The Takeover Plan**

Davos has spent decades positioning himself to take control of the
entire Goldshore house. He has forged documents, bribed witnesses, and
compiled blackmail on Lord Aldris IV.

**The Salvage Operation**

Has secret expeditions searching the sunken palace for treasures. Found
several artifacts, kept quiet. One might be the Crown Jewels---which he
plans to use as leverage.

**The Poison Prince**

Maintains a poisoner on permanent staff. Has eliminated at least seven
business rivals. Never caught.

**The Insurance Policy**

Has compromising information on dozens of nobles, merchants, and
officials. Files hidden in several locations. If he dies, they're
released.

#### Notable Quotes


*"Gold opens doors that armies cannot breach, and silence is the most
profitable investment."*

### 37.8 Lady Morgana Blackwater

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mixologee/tirvandor/main/tirvandor-project/all_artwork/npcs/tirvandor-npc-lady-morgana-blackwater.jpg){width:200px,float:right,margin:5px}

**Ruler of Marshaven, Necromancer**

#### Titles & Aliases


-   Lady of Marshaven

-   Mistress of the Thornmire

-   The Widow Blackwater

#### Age & Physical Description


**Age:** Mid-forties

Lady Morgana carries herself with the cold dignity of old nobility. She
dresses in dark colors befitting her widowed status and the perpetual
gloom of Marshaven. Her features are sharp and her eyes miss nothing.

**Threat Level:** Extremely dangerous. A powerful necromancer who has
secretly created an army of intelligent undead hidden in the swamps. Her
undead retain their memories and personalities---not shambling corpses,
but thinking soldiers. She currently commands approximately two hundred
such servants, with the number growing.

#### Personality & Mannerisms


**Core Traits:**

-   Cold pragmatism disguised as proper nobility

-   Sees herself as a liberator, not a villain

-   Believes the ends justify the means

-   Genuinely cares about Marshaven's independence

**Defining Principles:**

-   The continental powers take Marshaven's taxes but provide nothing
    in return

-   Independence is worth any price

-   The dead are a resource, like any other

#### Complete Background & History


Born to a minor noble family in the Thornmire swamps. Married into the
Blackwater name---the oldest family in Marshaven. Her husband died three
years into the marriage under mysterious circumstances. She's ruled the
city ever since.

{{pageNumber,auto}}
{{footnote Chapter 37: Nobility and Aristocracy}}
\page

Marshaven has always been overlooked: too swampy, too poor, too strange.
The continental powers take its taxes but provide nothing in return.
Morgana decided to change that.

Using forbidden texts found in swamp ruins, she's learned to create
undead that retain their intelligence and free will---not shambling
corpses, but thinking soldiers. Her plan is elegant: build an army in
the swamps where no one looks, then declare independence.

#### Relationships & Connections


-   **Advisor:** Master Alchemist Varek (knows some of her plans)

-   **Secret Army:** Currently 200 intelligent undead hidden in deep
    swamps

-   **Ally:** Sage-Speaker Sss'rith of the lizardfolk (supports
    independence, doesn't know about undead)

-   **Political Cover:** General Marthos Thandris (provides protection
    in exchange for intelligence)

#### Secrets


**The Undead Army**

Two hundred and growing. Hidden in flooded ruins. Loyal to her through a
modified binding ritual.

**The Husband's Death**

He discovered her early experiments. She didn't kill him---her first
creation did. She's never forgiven herself.

**The Intelligence Ritual**

Her undead retain memories and personality. Some thank her for the
second chance. Some hate her.

**The Timeline**

Needs five hundred undead for her plan. At current rate: five years.

### 37.9 Council Mistress Elara Silverleaf

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mixologee/tirvandor/main/tirvandor-project/all_artwork/npcs/tirvandor-npc-council-mistress-elara-silverleaf.jpg){width:200px,float:right,margin:5px}

**Head of Silverpine Council, University Rector**

#### Titles & Aliases


-   Council Mistress of Silverpine

-   Rector of the University of Arcane Studies

-   Matriarch of House Silverleaf (former---passed duties to focus on
    academia)
\column
#### Age & Physical Description


**Age:** 342 years old (born 905 CR); appears mid-thirties

Elegant and composed, standing five feet seven inches and weighing one
hundred twenty-five pounds, with the timeless beauty of high elves.
Auburn hair with silver highlights worn in a complex braided style.
Bright silver eyes that miss nothing.

Always dressed in academic robes---burgundy with silver
trim---indicating her rank as Rector. Wears spectacles for reading
(doesn't actually need them, but they make her look scholarly).

**Threat Level:** One of the most powerful abjuration mages alive. Her
protective magic makes her nearly impossible to kill, and her mastery of
counterspell and dispel magic means she can shut down most magical
threats. More significantly, she controls the premier magical
institution in western Tirvandor and has trained hundreds of wizards now
in positions of power.

#### Personality & Mannerisms


**Core Traits:**

-   Precise and organized---everything in its place

-   Listens carefully before speaking, then speaks with authority

-   Uses hand gestures when explaining complex concepts

-   Corrects people politely when they're wrong

**Voice:** Clear, precise, academic. Uses technical terms. Speaks in
complete paragraphs.

**Defining Principles:**

-   *"An educated populace is a free populace."*

-   *"Magic should be used to protect, not destroy."*

-   *"Good enough is the enemy of great."*

-   *"Knowledge is not power---applied knowledge is power."*

#### Complete Background & History


Born in 905 CR in Aethermere. Showed magical talent young. Sent to
Silverpine Magical Academy at age forty. Proved to be a prodigy in
abjuration magic---by age eighty, was a full professor.

Appointed Rector of the University at age 250 (1155 CR)---youngest
Rector in university history. Under her leadership, the University has
grown to be the premier magical institution in western Tirvandor.

Also leads the Silverpine Council, making her both academic and
political leader of the city. Never married---devoted entirely to her
work. Considers her students her children.

#### Secrets


**The Forbidden Vault**

The University has a vault of dangerous magical knowledge. Only she has
access. Contains things that shouldn't exist---necromancy tomes, demon
summoning, reality-breaking spells. She's studied them all "to know
how to counter them."

{{pageNumber,auto}}
{{footnote Chapter 37: Nobility and Aristocracy}}
\page

**The Staff Fragment**

Her Staff of Power contains a fragment of an ancient artifact. If
reassembled with other fragments, it would create a world-shattering
weapon. She guards it carefully.

**The Personal Ward**

Created a permanent personal ward on herself years ago. It's slowly
draining her life force. In fifty to one hundred years, it will kill
her. She's trying to fix it without removing the protection.

### 37.10 Trade Prince Lucian Goldfingers

![37.10 Trade Prince Lucian Goldfingers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mixologee/tirvandor/main/tirvandor-project/all_artwork/npcs/tirvandor-npc-lucian-goldfingers.jpg){width:200px,float:right,margin:5px}


**Trade Prince of the Merchant League**

#### Titles & Aliases


-   Trade Prince

-   Master of the Goldfingers Trading Company

-   The Bastard Prince (rarely used to his face)

#### Age & Physical Description


**Age:** Mid-sixties (half-elf, appears mid-forties)

Carries himself with the casual confidence of someone who has nothing
left to prove. Well-dressed in a way that suggests wealth without
flaunting it.

**Threat Level:** Dangerous primarily through wealth and connections.
Lucian controls a merchant empire spanning both continents and sits on
the Merchant League's inner council as one of the three Trade Princes
who truly control continental commerce. He funds both sides of several
conflicts and has destabilization agents creating tensions across
Tirvandor---not from patriotism, but profit.

#### Complete Background & History


Born in the gutters of Port Myrthen, a half-elf bastard of a merchant
lord who refused to acknowledge him. Survived by theft and wit until he
blackmailed his father into funding his education. Proved to be a
prodigy of commerce, multiplying his starting funds a hundredfold within
a decade.

When his father died, Lucian revealed the blackmail material
anyway---not for revenge, but to eliminate rivals who knew the truth. He
absorbed his father's trading company and used it to build a merchant
empire spanning both continents.

His public persona is the charming rogue, the common-born success story.
Privately, he's ruthless, patient, and never forgives a slight. He
doesn't want money---he has more than he could spend in several
lifetimes. He wants power, respect, and eventually to reshape the
world's economy in his image.

#### Secrets


**The Father's Murder**

Arranged his father's death to look natural. The man was planning to
expose and disinherit him.

**The Currency Plot**

Slowly manipulating exchange rates to eventually give him control over
the continental economy.

**The Legacy Project**

Funding archaeological expeditions to find pre-Worldrend trade magic.
Wants to revolutionize commerce.

### 37.11 Lady Tempest Stormcrest

![37.11 Lady Tempest Stormcrest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mixologee/tirvandor/main/tirvandor-project/all_artwork/npcs/tirvandor-npc-lady-tempest-stormcrest.jpg){width:200px,float:right,margin:5px}


**Storm-Caller of House Stormcrest**

#### Titles & Aliases


-   Lady Tempest

-   The Storm-Caller

-   The Weather Witch (derisive)

#### Age & Physical Description


**Age:** 35 years old (born 1212 CR)

Wild and striking, standing five feet nine inches and weighing one
hundred forty pounds, with an intensity that makes people step back.
Long black hair that seems to move with static electricity even when
there's no wind. Eyes that shift from gray to electric blue depending
on her mood. Olive skin with lightning-bolt scars from channeling power.

Wears flowing dark robes that billow dramatically. Has a presence that
fills rooms---electric and slightly dangerous.

**Threat Level:** Terrifyingly powerful but unstable. Lady Tempest can
summon hurricanes, call lightning from clear skies, and control weather
across miles. However, her powers are tied to her emotions, and when she
loses control, ships sink and people die. She is simultaneously one of
House Stormcrest's greatest assets and their greatest liability.

{{pageNumber,auto}}
{{footnote Chapter 37: Nobility and Aristocracy}}
\page

#### Personality & Mannerisms


**Core Traits:**

-   Passionate and intense, everything at 100%

-   Impulsive---acts on instinct rather than thought

-   Moody---temperament literally matches the weather

-   Generous with power but careless about consequences

**Voice:** Ranges from whisper to shout, crackling with static when
emotional.

**Defining Principles:**

-   *"I am the storm---wild, untamed, free. No one controls me."*

-   *"Nature's fury flows through me. Why should I restrain it?"*

-   *"The storm doesn't ask permission. Neither do I."*

**Personal Flaws:**

-   Volatile---anger can cause literal storms

-   Reckless---doesn't think about collateral damage

-   Addicted to power---the rush of controlling weather

-   Struggles with controlling her abilities

#### Complete Background & History


Born in 1212 CR, Tempest was always different. At thirteen, during a
tantrum, she called lightning without meaning to. Burned down a dock.
Killed three people.

House Stormcrest recognized sorcerous bloodline manifesting and hired
teachers to help her control it. All failed to truly teach control
because the power is tied to her emotions.

By twenty, she could call storms. By twenty-five, she could control
weather. By thirty, she could summon hurricanes. But control remains
imperfect. When she's angry, ships sink. When she's sad, it rains for
days.

Recently, her power is growing. Weather responds to her moods even when
she's not trying. She's starting to hear whispers in
storms---something calling to her from deep weather patterns.
\column
#### Secrets


**The Growing Power**

Her magic is increasing beyond her control. She can feel weather
patterns hundreds of miles away. Soon, she might affect entire
continental weather. Is she becoming something inhuman?

**The Calling**

Something in storms is calling to her---an ancient presence, possibly an
elder elemental or sleeping god. The calling is seductive. It promises
ultimate power and freedom. She's tempted.

**The Accident**

The sailor Erik didn't die accidentally. He was assaulting her. Her
lightning strike was self-defense. But she told her brother it was an
accident because she was ashamed and scared.

**The Bargain**

A storm elemental once offered her a pact---merge with it, become purely
elemental, have perfect control and unlimited power. She'd stop being
human but become an eternal storm. She refused but sometimes wishes
she'd accepted.

#### Notable Quotes


*"The storm doesn't ask permission. Neither do I."*

*"I am the storm. You're just in it."*

{{pageNumber,auto}}
{{footnote Chapter 37: Nobility and Aristocracy}}
\page

## Chapter 38: Religious Leaders

### 38.1 High Priest Rashid Al-Sahir

![38.1 ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mixologee/tirvandor/main/tirvandor-project/all_artwork/npcs/tirvandor-npc-high-priest-rashid-al-sahir.jpg){width:195px,float:right,margin:5px}

**Title:** High Priest of Sundara, Chief Spiritual Advisor to the Sultan

**Location:** Sundara, The Oasis Palace

**Age:** 68 (human)

Elderly but vigorous, with dark skin weathered by desert sun. Long white
beard braided with golden rings. Deep brown eyes filled with wisdom and
kindness. Bald head covered with white turban adorned with sapphire.
Moves with surprising grace for his age. Always dressed in white robes
with gold trim.

Born in Sundara in 1179 CR to a merchant family. Experienced divine
vision at age 16---saw Sera in the sun and dedicated his life to
service. Trained as cleric, became respected spiritual leader by age 30.
Appointed High Priest at age 45 (1224 CR) by the newly crowned Sultan
Rashid Ashborne.

**The Two Blessings:** Rashid is known as "The Twice-Blessed" for
surviving two lethal situations through divine intervention. During a
plague at age 22, he healed hundreds until he collapsed from exhaustion.
Sera himself appeared and restored him. At age 50, during a sandstorm,
he went into the desert to rescue a lost child. Caught in the storm,
nearly dying of dehydration, Sera sent rain in the desert---saving both.
These miracles make him a living legend.

**Secrets:** Rashid knows he can call Divine Intervention one more time
before he dies---Sera told him so. He is saving it for the moment of
greatest need. He also knows the Great Oasis is slowly dying from a
curse, but hasn't told anyone to avoid causing panic.

**Connections:** Sultan Rashid Ashborne (mutual respect), Archdruid
Silvaris Oakenheart (close friend), Desert Ranger Khalid (spiritual
mentorship), Merchant Prince Davos Goldshore (cautious alliance)

### 38.2 Archdruid Silvaris Oakenheart

![38.2 Archdruid Silvaris Oakenheart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mixologee/tirvandor/main/tirvandor-project/all_artwork/npcs/tirvandor-npc-silvaris.jpg){width:195px,float:right,margin:5px}


**Title:** Chief Archdruid of the Silverwood Circle

**Location:** Silverpine, Old Oak Circle

**Age:** 412 (elf)

Ancient elven druid who serves as the spiritual guide for the Silverwood
and surrounding regions. Silvaris maintains the balance between
civilization and nature in the Heartlands. She advises both Thaldrosian
nobles and common folk on matters affecting the forest, and her counsel
carries tremendous weight.

Silvaris was born before the Worldrend and remembers the cataclysm
firsthand. This ancient perspective gives her wisdom that few can match.
She believes the current era's conflicts are symptoms of deeper
imbalances in the world's natural order.

**Connections:** High Queen Aelindra Aethermere (distant respect), High
Priest Rashid Al-Sahir (mutual respect between cleric and druid
traditions), House Verdantheart (fellow druids)

### 38.3 The Sand Prophet

![38.3 ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mixologee/tirvandor/main/tirvandor-project/all_artwork/npcs/tirvandor-npc-the-sand-prophet.jpg){width:195px,float:right,margin:5px}

**Title:** Desert Oracle

**Location:** Unknown location in the Sundaran Expanse

A mysterious oracle who dwells somewhere in the deep desert. The Sand
Prophet delivers cryptic prophecies that sometimes confirm and sometimes
contradict the visions of other seers. Few have met the Prophet
directly---most receive their wisdom through intermediaries or dreams.

High Priest Al-Sahir has regular contact with the Sand Prophet, though
he does not fully understand the oracle's nature or motivations.
Recently, the Sand Prophet has gone silent, causing concern among those
who rely on their guidance.

**Secret:** The Sand Prophet may not be a single individual but rather a
title passed down through generations---or something else entirely.

## Chapter 39: Military Commanders


### 39.1 General Marthos Thandris


**Title:** General of the Border Legions

**Location:** Contested Lands frontier

Distant cousin to King Aldric IV, Marthos commands Thaldros' forces in
the Contested Lands. A calculating military mind who prioritizes
strategic advantage over glory. He maintains the tenuous border with
Aethoria and manages the complex relationships with independent
settlements in the frontier.

**Secret:** Marthos knows Crown Prince Thorin was born before King
Aldric married Queen Mara---the official records have been altered. He
holds this information as leverage, though he has never used it.

### 39.2 Captain Vex


**Title:** Thaldrosian Border Officer

**Location:** Contested Lands

A confident officer tasked with capturing Resistance leaders in the
Contested Lands. Vex uses infiltrators and spies to set traps, though
his overconfidence often leads to underestimating opponents. Has
reinforcements available within one hour of any engagement.

\column

### 39.3 Scout Captain Finn Quickfoot

![39.4 Scout Captain Finn Quickfoot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mixologee/tirvandor/main/tirvandor-project/all_artwork/npcs/tirvandor-npc-scout-captain-finn-quickfoot.jpg){width:200px,float:right,margin:5px}


**Title:** Captain of the Royal Scouts

**Location:** Mobile, operates throughout Thaldros

**Age:** 47 (halfling)

The fastest and most cunning scout in Thaldrosian service. Finn leads a
network of rangers and scouts who gather intelligence across the realm.
His small stature and unassuming appearance make him perfect for
infiltration missions.

Despite his cheerful demeanor, Finn has survived more dangerous
situations than most soldiers see in a lifetime. He is utterly loyal to
Lord Commander Thrain, who gave him a chance when others dismissed him
for his size.

## Chapter 40: Merchants and Guild Leaders


### 40.1 Merchant Prince Davos Goldshore


**Title:** Merchant Prince of Goldreach, Leader of the Goldshore Branch
Family

**Location:** Goldreach, Goldshore Manor

**Age:** 157 (half-elf)

Distinguished and handsome, with the ageless quality of half-elves. Dark
hair streaked with silver, kept impeccably groomed. Green eyes that seem
to calculate your worth when they look at you. Always impeccably dressed
in finest clothes. Currently the richest individual in Tirvandor---worth
an estimated 8-10 million gold pieces.

Davos controls approximately 40% of maritime trade between
continents---more than the "main" branch of House Goldshore. He
officially serves as the family's Merchant Prince, handling day-to-day
commerce while the Aldris line maintains noble legitimacy. In practice,
Davos wields more actual power and secretly resents the arrangement.

**Ultimate Goal:** Reunite the Goldshore branches under his leadership
through legal manipulation, blackmail, or more direct means.

**Secrets:** Has forged documents, bribed witnesses, and compiled
blackmail on Lord Aldris IV for his planned takeover. Maintains a
poisoner on permanent staff and has eliminated at least seven business
rivals. Secretly funds Syndicate operations for deniable work against
the main Goldshore branch.

**Connections:** Sultan Rashid Ashborne (trade agreements), Lord Aldris
IV Goldshore (rival), Trade Prince Lucian Goldfingers (competitor),
Master Crimson (unwitting tool)

### 40.2 Master Smith Durgan Forgefire


**Title:** Guildmaster of the Kaer Thandros Smithing Guild

**Location:** Kaer Thandros, The Crown Forge

**Age:** 234 (dwarf)

The finest smith in Thaldros and possibly all of Tirvandor. Durgan's
work is legendary---kings and archmages pay fortunes for his creations.
He operates the Crown Forge, one of only three forges in the world
capable of creating permanent magical items.

Despite his wealth and status, Durgan lives simply. He cares only for
his craft and becomes genuinely animated only when discussing metallurgy
or examining interesting ore samples. He has trained hundreds of
apprentices, many of whom now run smithies across both continents.

**Secret:** Durgan knows the location of a mythril vein that could
supply the forge for centuries, but mining it would disturb something
sealed beneath the mountains.

### 40.3 Trade Prince Lucian Goldfingers

![40.3 Trade Prince Lucian Goldfingers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mixologee/tirvandor/main/tirvandor-project/all_artwork/npcs/tirvandor-npc-lucian-goldfingers.jpg){width:200px,float:right,margin:5px}


**Title:** Master of the Merchant League

**Location:** Crossvale

Leader of the Merchant League, a coalition of independent traders who
compete with the great trading houses. Lucian resents the power of House
Goldshore and constantly schemes to undermine their monopolies. He
distrusts military spending and clashes frequently with Lord Commander
Thrain.

### 40.4 Captain Sylara Windchaser


**Title:** Master of the Goldshore Merchant Fleet

**Location:** Goldreach Harbor

Commands Davos Goldshore's merchant fleet---the largest private naval
force on the western continent. Sylara is a skilled navigator who knows
every current and reef in the Sundering Sea. Her loyalty to Davos is
absolute, though she has growing concerns about some of his more
ruthless methods.

## Chapter 41: Criminals and Underworld Figures


### 41.1 Master Crimson

![41.1 Master Crimson](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mixologee/tirvandor/main/tirvandor-project/all_artwork/npcs/tirvandor-npc-master-crimson.jpg){width:200px,float:right,margin:5px}


**Title:** Leader of the Thornwood Syndicate

**Location:** Unknown, operates throughout Thaldros

The mysterious figure who controls the Thornwood Syndicate, the most
powerful criminal organization in western Tirvandor. No one knows Master
Crimson's true identity---the name may be a title rather than an
individual. The Syndicate operates in smuggling, protection rackets,
assassination, and information brokerage.

Master Crimson maintains a network of lieutenants who carry out
operations while keeping the master's identity secret. The organization
has infiltrated merchant guilds, noble houses, and even military units.
They are particularly active in Goldreach, Crossvale, and the Contested
Lands.

**Secret:** Master Crimson is actually being manipulated by Merchant
Prince Davos Goldshore, though the Syndicate doesn't know this. Davos
uses them for deniable operations while publicly opposing their
activities.

**Connections:** Various noble patrons (blackmail), corrupt city
officials, Merchant Prince Davos Goldshore (unknowing puppet)

### 41.2 Whisper


**Title:** Legendary Thief

**Location:** Mobile, often in Goldreach

The most famous thief in Tirvandor---Whisper's exploits are legendary.
She has stolen from dragon hoards, royal treasuries, and wizard towers.
No vault is considered truly secure until Whisper has failed to crack
it---and she has yet to fail.

Whisper works independently, taking contracts that interest her rather
than for pure profit. She has a code: no theft that would cause innocent
deaths, no jobs targeting orphanages or temples of good deities, and no
working with slavers. These principles have earned her grudging respect
even from those she's robbed.

**Appearance:** Average height, forgettable features---the perfect
qualities for a thief. Those who have seen her describe different
appearances, suggesting she is a master of disguise.

### 41.3 Vexis Shadowmaw


**Title:** Warlock and Cult Leader

**Location:** Contested Lands, mobile

A tiefling warlock who serves a fiendish patron. Vexis leads a small but
dangerous cult that seeks to summon their patron into the material
world. She is ambitious, cruel, and utterly devoted to her dark master.

**Goals:** Vexis seeks ancient artifacts that could weaken the barriers
between planes. She has particular interest in sites connected to the
Bound Ancients, believing their prisons contain the power she needs.

### 41.4 High Voidcaller Malthus


**Title:** Leader of the Temple of the Void Saints

**Location:** Contested Lands, moving camp

Leader of a cult worshipping The Devourer, one of the Bound Ancients.
Malthus believes the void will bring transcendence and actively works to
weaken the Devourer's prison. The cult raids settlements for sacrifices
and seeks Bound Ancient artifacts.

**Threat Level:** Extremely dangerous. The cult's activities could
trigger a catastrophic release if successful.

## Chapter 42: Scholars and Mages


### 42.1 Sage Thelmar Runescribe


**Title:** Royal Diviner of Thaldros

**Location:** Kaer Thandros, Royal Library

**Age:** 67 (human)

The most accomplished divination wizard in Thaldros, Thelmar serves as
advisor to King Aldric IV on matters of prophecy and magical
intelligence. His Portent ability---seeing glimpses of the future each
morning---has saved the kingdom from disaster multiple times.

Thelmar is an elderly human with a scholar's stoop and ink-stained
fingers. He cares more for knowledge than politics, though he
understands that knowledge without application serves no one. He
maintains the Royal Library's collection of prophecies and works
constantly to interpret their meanings.

**Secret:** Thelmar has seen fragments of a potential Second Worldrend
in his divinations but cannot determine if it's prophecy or mere
possibility.

### 42.2 Professor Elara Moonwhisper

![42.2 Professor Elara Moonwhisper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mixologee/tirvandor/main/tirvandor-project/all_artwork/npcs/tirvandor-npc-professor-elara-moonwhisper.jpg){width:200px,float:right,margin:5px}


**Title:** Professor of Divination, Silverpine Academy

**Location:** Silverpine

**Age:** 342 (elf)

An elven wizard who teaches at the famous Silverpine Magical Academy.
Elara specializes in combining divination magic with natural lore,
creating unique techniques for reading portents in natural phenomena.

She takes a particular interest in talented students from non-magical
backgrounds, believing raw talent matters more than bloodline. Several
of her former students have become influential mages across both
continents.

### 42.3 Archmage Eldrin Aethermere


**Title:** Royal Archmage of Aethoria, Prince of House Aethermere

**Location:** Aethermere, the World-Tree Palace

**Age:** 158 (elf)

Eldest child of High Queen Aelindra, Eldrin serves as the realm's most
powerful wizard and chief magical advisor. Though he cannot inherit the
throne (succession works differently in Aethoria), his magical and
political influence is immense.

Eldrin is methodical and scholarly, preferring research to court
politics. He maintains the magical wards protecting Aethermere and
studies the ancient magics of the World-Trees. His relationship with his
mother is complex---he respects her but questions some of her more
secretive decisions.

### 42.4 Archmage Veridian Starweaver

![42.4 Archmage Veridian Starweaver](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mixologee/tirvandor/main/tirvandor-project/all_artwork/npcs/tirvandor-npc-archmage-veridian-starweaver.jpg){width:200px,float:right,margin:5px}


**Title:** Archmagister of House Starweaver

**Location:** Starfall Observatory

**Age:** 612 (elf)

Ancient even by elven standards, Veridian leads House Starweaver and the
famous Starfall Observatory. He is brilliant beyond question but
deliberately cryptic in all communications. He cares more about stars
than politics, dismissing continental conflicts as "brief fluctuations
in the cosmic order."

**Secret:** Something terrifies Veridian---something he discovered long
ago and has spent centuries trying to understand or prevent. The Sealed
Prophecy of the 1050s, when the Observatory went dark for an entire
year, holds secrets he will not share. The stars are showing strange
patterns again---patterns senior Starweavers recognize but will not
discuss.

### 42.5 Professor Miranda Questseeker

![42.5 Professor Miranda Questseeker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mixologee/tirvandor/main/tirvandor-project/all_artwork/npcs/tirvandor-npc-professor-miranda-questseeker.jpg){width:200px,float:right,margin:5px}


**Title:** Professor of Archaeology, Silverpine Academy

**Location:** Silverpine, often on expeditions

A human scholar dedicated to uncovering pre-Worldrend history. Miranda
leads expeditions to ancient ruins across both continents, seeking to
understand the civilizations that existed before the cataclysm.

Her discoveries have rewritten understanding of several historical
periods, though some of her more controversial findings have been
suppressed by authorities uncomfortable with their implications.

## Chapter 43: Adventurers and Heroes


### 43.1 Desert Ranger Khalid


**Title:** Warden of the Sundaran Expanse

**Location:** Sundaran Expanse, mobile

**Age:** 34 (human)

A skilled ranger who protects travelers and hunts monsters in the
Sundaran desert. Khalid is honorable to a fault, which sometimes puts
him at odds with the more pragmatic Sultan Ashborne. High Priest
Al-Sahir serves as his spiritual mentor, trying to temper his
righteousness with mercy.

Khalid knows the desert better than anyone alive. He can navigate by
stars, find water where none should exist, and track enemies across
shifting sands. His reputation as a protector of the innocent has made
him beloved by common folk and respected even by the bandits he hunts.

**Secret:** Khalid's family was killed by bandits when he was young.
His devotion to justice borders on obsession, and he sometimes pursues
vengeance beyond what wisdom would advise.

### 43.2 Ranger-Lord Arannis Silverleaf


**Title:** Warden of the Silverwood, Lord of House Silverleaf

**Location:** Silverwood

**Age:** 487 (elf)

The greatest ranger of the western continent, Arannis protects the
Silverwood and serves as liaison between elven and human communities.
His tracking skills are legendary---it's said he can follow a bird
through the sky by the disturbance it leaves in the air.

Arannis leads the Silverwood Rangers, an elite force that patrols the
forest and responds to threats throughout the Heartlands. He maintains
secret contact with his distant cousins in House Starweaver across the
sea, working quietly toward healing the schism between eastern and
western elves.

### 43.3 Ranger-Lord Silvanus


**Title:** The Vampire Slayer

**Location:** Mobile, wherever undead threaten

A human ranger who has dedicated his life to destroying undead,
particularly vampires. Silvanus has destroyed more vampires than any
living hunter, earning him the title "Vampire Slayer" and the eternal
enmity of undead across Tirvandor.

His methods are brutal but effective. He shows no mercy to undead or
those who serve them willingly. However, he goes to great lengths to
protect innocents, including those who have been turned against their
will and might be saved.

**Secret:** Silvanus' obsession stems from his wife's transformation
into a vampire. He was forced to destroy her himself and has hunted
undead ever since.

### 43.4 Captain Lyra Stormwind


**Title:** Adventurer, Former Privateer

**Location:** Port Myrthen, The Drifting Chain

A former privateer who now leads a company of adventurers based in Port
Myrthen. Lyra knows the Sundering Sea better than most and has contacts
on both continents. Her ship, the *Storm's Edge*, is available for hire
to those with interesting jobs and sufficient coin.

Lyra operates in moral gray areas---she won't transport slaves or help
genuine villains, but she's not above smuggling or bending laws that
she considers unjust. Her crew is fiercely loyal, and her reputation for
completing jobs makes her services highly sought.
